# Latent Space

> > The AI Engineer podcast and community exploring AI infrastructure, compute optimization, venture capital, and the future of simulative AI.

Latent Space features in-depth conversations with leading figures from OpenAI, a16z, Modular, Liquid AI, Nous Research, and other frontier AI companies. The site covers hardware acceleration, custom ASICs, LLM performance optimization, and emerging paradigms like simulative AI and WebSim.

## Key Topics

- AI Infrastructure & Compute
- Hardware Acceleration & Custom ASICs
- LLM Performance & Inference Optimization
- Simulative AI & WebSim
- AI Venture Capital & Economics
- OpenAI & Anthropic
- Modular & CUDA Alternatives
- Liquid AI & Nous Research
- Cursor & AI-Native Tools
- Tokens per Second Optimization
- AI Podcast Interviews
- Prompt Engineering Critique
- Dead Internet Theory & AI Media
- Chris Lattner on Compute
- Martin Casado & Sarah Wang (a16z)

## AI Infrastructure & Hardware

- [The Shape of Compute — with Chris Lattner for Modular](https://www.latent.space/p/modular-2025): Chris Lattner on Modular/Mojo, CUDA monopoly, and AMD performance parity
- [[AINews] The Custom ASIC Thesis](https://www.latent.space/p/ainews-the-custom-asic-thesis): Taalas HC1 custom silicon achieves 16,960 tok/s/user on Llama 3.1 8B

## AI Venture Capital & Strategy

- [Bitter Lessons in Venture vs Growth: Anthropic vs OpenAI, Noam Shazeer, World Labs, Thinking Machines, Cursor, ASIC Economics — Martin Casado & Sarah Wang of a16z](https://www.latent.space/p/a16z): a16z's Martin Casado & Sarah Wang on AI investing and venture strategy

## Simulative AI & New Paradigms

- [WebSim, WorldSim, and The Summer of Simulative AI — with Joscha Bach of Liquid AI, Karan Malhotra of Nous Research, Rob Haisfield of WebSim.ai](https://www.latent.space/p/sim-ai): Simulative AI discussion with Joscha Bach, Karan Malhotra, Rob Haisfield

## AI Analysis & Critique

- [Why "Prompt Engineering" and "Generative AI" are overhyped](https://www.latent.space/p/why-prompt-engineering-and-generative): Critical analysis of AI hype via Stable Diffusion 2.0 and Meta's Galactica
- [[AINews] Truth in the time of Artifice](https://www.latent.space/p/ainews-truth-in-the-time-of-artifice): AI news examining media trust, misinformation, and dead internet theory
